subject: Data stewardship & evidence handling during P0 throughput/latency surge
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@merchantco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production degradation — latency & 5xx spike, need logs preserved immediately

Hi Jordan / Monica,

We're seeing a sustained throughput drop and elevated 5xx rate starting ~08:50 UTC this morning across our US region traffic routed to your hosted endpoints. Tail latency jumped to ~1.8s and error rate spiked to ~4.6% for ~25 minutes; we have customers reporting timeouts. Our legal/compliance team is asking for preserved request/response logs, KV cache snapshots, and a hashed token handling summary for an internal post-mortem — they specifically asked that nothing be deleted and that chain-of-custody be documented.

Can you confirm preservation and what evidence package you can provide (log formats, time range, redaction steps)? We need to prepare a short executive update for our CTO by 14:00 PT.

Attachments: None (we can share spans if helpful)

Thanks,
Sarah
Sr. Platform Ops, MerchantCo

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@merchantco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 09:26:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Production degradation — latency & 5xx spike, need logs preserved immediately

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and I'm really sorry for the disruption. We're treating this as a P0. Quick answers up front:

- Preservation: we will place an immediate hold on rolling retention for the affected tenant (MerchantCo) and snapshot telemetry + request/response logs for the window you provided.
- Evidence package: we'll produce a time-ordered archive (logs, sampling of request/response bodies where permitted, KV-cache snapshot metadata) and an audit manifest describing collection times and hashes.
- Redaction: PII/token redaction will be applied according to our standard incident workflow; Naomi, Monica — I'll defer to your guidance on the exact sanitization we should apply.

To help us scope the package: can you confirm the exact UTC window you need preserved (your note said starting ~08:50 UTC; do you want the 30 minutes before and after?) and whether your CTO needs raw request bodies or a redacted sample? If you prefer a phone call, I'm available at 9:45 PT.

I'll start the hold now and CC security + CS for evidence handling.

—Jordan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@merchantco.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 10:05:42 -07:00
Subject: RE: Production degradation — latency & 5xx spike, need logs preserved immediately

Jordan / Monica / Sarah — logging & evidence checklist below. I'm putting this in the thread so MerchantCo's compliance folks have the details they need.

1) Immediate preservation actions (already kicked off)
   - Retention hold applied to MerchantCo tenant: no automated deletion for 14 days (can be extended).
   - Live snapshot created: request logs, nginx front-proxy logs, model-runtime token handling traces (metadata only), KV-cache index metadata. Snapshot saved to secure S3 path (read-only for evidence team).

2) Evidence package contents (what we'll deliver)
   - request_logs_UTC_20280809_0840-0910.tar.gz (full structured logs, gzip)
   - response_samples_redacted_UTC_20280809_0845-0905.csv (redacted samples; bodies truncated)
   - kv_snapshot_index_20280809.json (metadata only; no raw keys)
   - runtime_metrics_timeseries_08-09-2028_UTC.csv
   - audit_manifest.pdf (collection times, SHA256 hashes, operator ids)

3) Redaction & token handling
   - We will not include raw bearer tokens or full unmasked PII in the delivered package. Fields containing tokens will be hashed (SHA256) and replaced with consistent pseudonyms to enable correlation without exposing secrets.
   - If MerchantCo requires raw artifacts for legal reasons, we'll need an approved legal request and an internal legal review; that process can take 24–48 hours.

4) Chain of custody and verification
   - Every artifact file will have an entry in the audit_manifest with file size, collection timestamp (UTC), operator id, and SHA256.
   - We'll provide a signed manifest (PDF) and a link to the immutable S3 snapshot.

5) Temporary escalation for executive briefing
   - Recommend we prepare a 1-page exec summary and attach the manifest + a small sample of redacted request/response rows. Jordan — if you want, Monica and I can produce the summary by 13:30 PT.

Action needed from MerchantCo: confirm UTC window to preserve and whether a redacted sample suffices for the CTO briefing.

—Naomi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@merchantco.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 12:02:13 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation — latency & 5xx spike, need logs preserved immediately

Sarah — confirmed on our side: we've preserved the window 2028-08-09T08:40:00Z through 2028-08-09T09:10:00Z (this covers the 10m pre- and post-spike) and created a read-only evidence bundle at s3://redwood-evidence/merchantco/2028-08-09/.

I've attached the incident_manifest.pdf which lists the files, collection operators, and the initial SHA256s. For the CTO briefing, we can provide the redacted sample CSV and the signed audit_manifest.pdf. If you need wider access, we'll coordinate a short NDA addendum — Naomi flagged that as an option for any request for raw bodies.

Attachments: [attachment: incident_manifest.pdf (pdf)]

Next steps we will do today:
- Generate exec summary + impact graph (Marissa) — target 13:10 PT
- Produce redacted sample CSV and upload to the evidence folder — target 12:45 PT
- Keep retention hold in place until MerchantCo confirms release window

—Monica
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@merchantco.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 16:48:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production degradation — latency & 5xx spike, need logs preserved immediately

Thanks all — quick exec note for MerchantCo's CTO and our internal leadership:

Summary (for execs)
- Impact: ~25-minute elevated error rate (peak 4.6%), tail latency increase to ~1.8s; affected requests routed to hosted-us-3 cluster during 08:50–09:15 UTC.
- Preservation: evidence snapshot created and placed in an immutable S3 path; audit_manifest.pdf and incident_manifest.pdf attached for verification.
- Data handling: delivered package will include redacted response samples and hashed token IDs; raw request bodies will not be provided without legal escalation.
- Next steps: security to finalize audit_manifest and sign; CS will prepare impact graph and a compact sample for CTO.

For Redwood leadership: we'll keep the 14-day retention hold and extend to 90 days if MerchantCo requests it. Naomi — please coordinate legal review if MerchantCo asks for unredacted artifacts. Marissa — add the exec summary to the HubSpot ticket and flag for renewal/credit conversation if the post-mortem shows customer impact (linking ticket HSP-4321).

Sarah — confirm acceptance of redacted sample for the CTO and we'll ship the package by 13:30 PT as discussed.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
